Use case: stylized-concept. Finished hero turnaround for 3D game reconstruction. Stylized hand-painted 3D game character art for a fast first-person roguelite shooter, targeting the readable, moderate-detail visual direction of Gunfire Reborn. Bold chunky silhouettes, slightly exaggerated proportions, broad clean faceted planes, two or three dominant color blocks, soft painted gradients and a few restrained edge accents. Simplify East-Asian fantasy motifs into recognizable medium-scale shapes. Use the chapter or character palette in the asset brief. Favor clear solid volume and consistent materials at normal gameplay distance. Matte stone, wood and cloth, restrained highlights on metal, sparse painted wear. No photorealism, micro-grain, dense tiny cracks, elaborate miniature carvings, harsh specular highlights or baked cast shadows. Even neutral lighting for reconstruction; prioritize silhouette and color coherence over surface detail.
Input is the current procedural reference of ONE anthropomorphic fox heroine, a proportion and pose reference only. Rebuild it as a polished sculpted game character: smoother cohesive organic surfaces, appealing expressive animal face, round substantial limbs and paws. Keep the reference standing height, joint placements, hand pose, three large curved tail placement and orthographic view orientation. Remove angular triangle piles and tiled tail segments. Not Minecraft or sharp triangulated origami; also no realistic texture noise.
Character: red fox female fire ranger with large expressive fox head, amber almond eyes, orange fur, cream muzzle and chest, dark ear tips and dark paws. Well-shaped short fox muzzle and friendly confident expression. Fitted but substantial brown leather ranger vest, a broad vermilion scarf, deep indigo trousers, tan shin wraps and sturdy boots. Simple bold gold clasps. THREE distinct thick sweeping fluffy orange tails, TWO raised behind each side and ONE lower curved tail, all with large cream tips. Big flowing uninterrupted tail curves with only a few broad sculpted fur clumps, not rows of shingles or serrated segments. Full orange/cream colour on all tails (reference tails are gray only because their shader is missing in export). Preserve all three tail trajectories and attachment locations in every view. Hands empty, no guns, no fire, no particles.
Exactly FOUR consistent full body orthographic views in ONE wide row: FRONT / LEFT (faces image left) / BACK / RIGHT (faces image right). Four equal panels, same figure scale, same feet baseline. Preserve reference relaxed right arm low / left forearm held in front and current leg stance, hands separated from torso. Identical character colours and volumes on all sides. Fully transparent background, no ground, shadow, text or frame. Clean hand-painted game art with soft gradients and readable broad forms.
